hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; casing and tubing handling by trained crews.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Surface casing
function: The string set below the freshwater aquifers and cemented to surface; it carries the wellhead and the BOP during drilling.

tabs.overview: Depth set by regulation to protect fresh water; cemented to surface; the casing head is welded or threaded onto it.
tabs.engineering: Per API 5CT; cement to surface per regulation.
tabs.safety: The regulatory string; cement returns to surface are confirmed.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
